name: Castle Game Engine
description: Create, check, compile, clean and package a Castle Game Engine game (Free Pascal) with the engine's own castle-engine tool. The compiler's messages come back as file(line,col), so the build summary box and Fix with agent work as for Pascal. Give the project's folder (the one with CastleEngineManifest.xml) as the input; 'New project' takes the PARENT folder and the new project's name in the extra arguments.
install_note: Fetch the official Linux x86-64 release (castle-engine-7.0-alpha.3-linux-x86_64.zip, about 715 MB) from https://github.com/castle-engine/castle-engine/releases and unpack it into ~/.local/share/cockpit/tools/castle/ so that castle_game_engine/bin/castle-engine exists (no root needed). Needs fpc too. The engine is licensed LGPL with a linking exception and the tools GPL: fetch it, do not bundle it.

presets.label: New game project
presets.description: Creates a new project (engine's empty template: a manifest, a main view, data/) in a subfolder of the folder you give. Type the project's name in the extra arguments (letters, digits, - and _). Never overwrites.

presets.label: Check (compile, leave nothing behind)
presets.description: Compiles the whole game, engine included, into a throw-away folder: finds every error and warning and changes nothing in the project. About 40 seconds, as the engine is compiled each time. Use Compile for quick repeat builds.

presets.label: Compile (the game's executable)
presets.description: castle-engine compile: builds the game for this machine into the project (the executable beside the manifest, castle-engine-output/ for the intermediate files). The first build compiles the engine (about 40 s), later ones only what changed.

presets.label: Clean (remove build leftovers)
presets.description: castle-engine clean: removes the files compiling and packaging left behind; the sources and the final packages stay.

presets.label: Package (Linux archive)
presets.description: castle-engine package: cleans, compiles in release mode and writes a Linux archive beside the project, ready to hand to a player. Can take several minutes.

presets.label: Engine, compiler and project manifest
presets.description: The engine and Free Pascal versions in use, and the project's CastleEngineManifest.xml.
